channel.title: Titel Media GmbH - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: Giorgio Armani's Final Collection Lives In Giorgio Armani's House
item.description: Giorgio Armani Spring/Summer 2026, the final collection designed by Mr. Armani, takes us inside the peerless designer's beautiful Milanese home.

item.title: Snob Diaries: On the I.C.E. in St. Moritz With Justin Kendall
item.description: For The I.C.E, Highsnob's own Justin Kendall takes us on a journey into the mountains to St. Moritz.

item.title: adidas Originals' Music Legacy Moves Forward With BigXthaPlug
item.description: Starring in the newest campaign for the adistar XLG, the Dallas M.C. becomes joins a long lineage of musicians with strong ties to the adidas brand.

item.title: Beautiful, Mother-of-Pearl... Running Shoes?
item.description: atmos' ASICS mother-of-pearl running shoes are an old-school flex, riffing on a traditional Japanese artform to create subtly gorgeous sneakers.

item.title: You Can Thank Marty Supreme for the $1,000 Timberland Puffer
item.description: The Welch Mountain Puffer Jacket was a humble Timberland classic. Now, it's a $1,000 jacket and a sign that this American workwear brand's going luxury.

item.title: This "Infrared"-Hot Re-Release of Nike's AJ6 Harks Back to Basketball History
item.description: To be linked back to Michael Jordan first championship win and an all-time fan favorite colorway, the Nike AJ6 "Infrared Salesman" is making a welcome return.

item.title: The Incredibly Stylish Return of Bob Marley's Favorite adidas Sneaker
item.description: Bob Marley's bold-patterned adidas' SL72 Jamaica sneaker is back once again, this time with even more homage.

item.title: In Gorgeous Tonal Pony Hair, Vans’ Authentic Goes Quiet Luxury
item.description: Vans occasionally reimagines its best silhouettes with a little extra spice. Here, that comes in the form of the beautifully bristly Vans Authentic Pony Hair.

item.title: adidas' Definitive Dad Shoe Has Now Got A Dad Bod
item.description: Headed for shoe racks this February, the adidas' bulky, bouncy, retro runner nods back to a style from Y2K days (with some added winter padding in places).

item.title: Nike’s Delicious “Olive” Dunks Aren’t Just an Appetizer. They’re the Main Course
item.description: The highly wearable Nike Dunk Low QS Medium Olive/Summit White keeps things tasty in the color department, utilizing a briny green base on pearly soles.
